resources.name: Krita
resources.description: Digital painting and illustration software for creative work.

free_details.limits: Canvas dimensions, brush complexity and animation affect memory needs. Store versions, optional services and third-party brushes can have separate conditions.
free_details.requirements: Platform availability is sourced from the provider download page. Check the exact operating-system version, CPU architecture, graphics drivers, and installer requirements.
free_details.cost_notes: Check hardware, hosting, optional services and third-party asset rights separately.

device_details.ram_scope: 4 GB minimum; 16 GB recommended by the official download page. Larger canvases/animation can need more.
device_details.graphics_requirement: OpenGL 3.0 or higher, or Direct3D 11. The documentation does not explicitly require a dedicated graphics card.

editorial.example: Create a small illustration with a separate sketch and color layer. Export a copy for sharing while retaining the editable document.
